description: Seed registry for DimSeniority. 'label' is the canonical value for DimSeniority.label. 'aliases' are surface forms mapped to it; there is no SeniorityAlias table in schema.sql, so they widen prompt matching and are dropped at load time. 'typical_min_exp' and 'typical_max_exp' are the years a label typically implies, which is what DimSeniority.typical_min_exp and DimSeniority.typical_max_exp hold: they describe the label itself, not any one posting, and are named apart from the min_exp/max_exp on the bridge tables because those are years a posting actually stated. They also drive the fallback for a posting that states years but never names a level, since the identifier reports the years and leaves the label null rather than guessing.
